## Names

<a id="sfx_sample_irq"></a>
### [`sfx_sample_irq`](../../../src/sfx_sample_player.asm#L6) `$29C8`

*routine*

Unreachable CIA1 timer B IRQ of a 1-bit sample player: CIA1 IRQs are off and nothing calls sfx_sample_start. Each IRQ toggles the SID volume between 0 and 15, then reads one sample byte through sfx_sample_ptr. The byte selects the timer B count to the next toggle from $0e00 (low) and $0f00 (high). Every raster handler jumps here on a non-VIC IRQ.
Acknowledge CIA1

<a id="sfx_sample_start"></a>
### [`sfx_sample_start`](../../../src/sfx_sample_player.asm#L47) `$2A0A`

*routine*

Unused set-up routine of the sample player: nothing calls it. It stops the CIA1 timers, sets sfx_sample_ptr = $0804 and sfx_sample_end = $0a04, clears the SID registers and sets sfx_volume = 15. Then it starts timer A (latch 8, continuous) and timer B (latch $0101, one-shot, counts timer A), with the timer B IRQ on.

- **Refers to:** [`sfx_sample_ptr`](../memory-map.md#sfx_sample_ptr), [`sfx_sample_end`](../memory-map.md#sfx_sample_end), [`figure_parts_unused`](figure_sprites_d000.md#figure_parts_unused)
